This is exactly Rule 206/207's own asymmetry (GAZETTE-FINDINGS.md #3): Rule 206 borrows Rule 207's telegraphic-transfer-buying-rate definition but not Rule 207's 'last published rate may be taken' fallback for an unpublished date. That gap is why elements.official_date = open even though valuation_method is settled -- there is a rate to apply, just no rule saying which date's rate. No VDA provisions -- no crypto in this case.
